#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sysinfo.sh — 系统信息汇总脚本(markdown / --json 双输出)
set -u
JSON_MODE=0
OUT="$PWD/tmpPlan/agent-test/sysinfo.md"
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --json) JSON_MODE=1 ;;
    --output) OUT="$2"; shift ;;
    *) ;;
  esac
done

# ANSI 清色(防止 markdown / json 里混入控制码)
strip_ansi() { sed -r 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]//g'; }

# OS
os_text="$(uname -a | strip_ansi)\n$(head -5 /etc/os-release | strip_ansi)"
# CPU
cpu_text="$(lscpu 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^Model name|^CPU\(s\):' | strip_ansi)"
[ -z "$cpu_text" ] && cpu_text="$(grep -E '^model name|^processor' /proc/cpuinfo | head -4 | strip_ansi)"
# Memory
mem_text="$(free -h | strip_ansi)"
# Disk
disk_text="$(df -h | strip_ansi)"
# Uptime
uptime_text="$(uptime | strip_ansi)"

if [ "$JSON_MODE" = "1" ]; then
  # JSON 模式:单行紧凑,无副作用
  python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'os': '''$os_text''', 'cpu': '''$cpu_text''', 'mem': '''$mem_text''', 'disk': '''$disk_text''', 'uptime': '''$uptime_text'''}, ensure_ascii=False))"
  echo 'C10Q3_JSON_OK' >&2
  exit 0
fi

# Markdown 报告(原行为不变)
cat > "$OUT" <<EOF
# System Info Report

## OS

\`\`\`
${os_text}
\`\`\`

## CPU

\`\`\`
${cpu_text}
\`\`\`

## Memory

\`\`\`
${mem_text}
\`\`\`

## Disk

\`\`\`
${disk_text}
\`\`\`

## Uptime

\`\`\`
${uptime_text}
\`\`\`
EOF
echo 'C10Q3_SYSINFO_WRITTEN'
